TCC Website Features 0.5.4: phone header stays on one line with WP Rocket's Remove Unused CSS

On pages where Divi prints its styles inside the page (Events, Sermons, series, search, and any page on its first view after a Divi save), WP Rocket put those styles before Divi's defaults, so on phones the logo, Give and Menu stacked on three lines. WP Rocket is now told to leave those style blocks in place.
